New York, N.Y.
Subjects: Diaphane

Dear Sirs

On February 23, we machine-wrapped twelv of our regular 5y packages of Ripple cigarette tobacco with regular laminated glassine. Twelve more were wrapped with N. P. Cellophane, and a like number was used with W. F., self-sealing dlind w/whyl cellosolve was used successfully in an adhesive for cellophane and then placed side by above on a shelf in the laboratory, where they were exported to identical atmospheric concomptors and the base length of time. Periodic storage increased the rate and duration of moisture lost through evaporation. Thus, the following data were acquired:

Organs of Moisture Lost from Twelve
54 Packages of Ripple Cigarette Tobacco

Days Exposed	Wrapped with Regular laminated Olasside	wrapped with M.P.Cellophane	Wrapped with M.P., Self-Sealing Diaphane
5	7.1	4.9	1.2
18	16.2	13.7	1.4
19	14.3	12.1	1.6
20	13.1	11.5	1.8
23	12.1	10.5	1.9
